charter.claim: Through the actual local E4B Ollama route, a specifically identified allied NPC can parse and apply each supported R-037 command only when an attributable native consequence and its material controls are retained.
charter.material_proof: For each matrix case retain the source/executable binding, E4B model/configuration, actor and request identifiers, prompt/response, parse/dispatch record, applying native turn and concrete consequence. Keep movement arrival, item ownership/safety, inventory state, target identity and combat damage/ammunition independent. Fixture setup supplies only opportunity. A failure records the same-case OpenAI gpt-4.1-mini comparison after secure readiness verification.
charter.current_uncertainty: E4B can choose an inappropriate command or fail formatting even under controlled natural requests. Each returned command and each material control has its own verdict; no sample establishes a model-quality ranking.
material_contradiction: a generated or manually injected response is credited as E4B output
the claimed recipient, item or combat target lacks exact same-run identity
an accepted request or posture is treated as a native consequence
a different model/provider's success erases the E4B result
OCR, rendered text, fixture setup or API transport is used as gameplay proof
forbidden_shortcuts: synthetic responses, parser-only proof, direct NPC/item/save mutation or physical input
claiming success from a fixture item, selector UI or queued enum alone
using an API result as local-E4B proof
honest_stop_conditions: separate a provider/model failure, parser rejection, dispatch deferral and native failure at its first evidenced divergence
preserve a failed local case and complete the authorized same-case API control where credentials are available
seal a claim-scoped bundle only after all observable matrix cases and cleanup are honestly classified
